hypothesis.primary: Bounded symbolic regression can recover predeclared simple analytic laws on synthetic independent test points.
hypothesis.null_control: Random labels must not be classified as law.
hypothesis.distribution_shift: A training-valid law that fails outside the observed regime must be rejected by the independent witness.

scientific_design.fitting: Train-set deterministic ordinary least squares with Gaussian pivot, test validity on validation, rank via validation NRMSE + fixed complexity penalty.
scientific_design.information_boundary: Discoverer receives only 30 train and 23 validation points per case. Witness receives only the discoverer's JSON, recreates source digest, constructs fresh unseen points from frozen public source; no discovery imports; no new external data source or real laboratory. Public source code means this is NOT cryptographically blind.
scientific_design.independent_execution: Separate GitHub Actions runner and code; read-only GitHub permissions; no upload to registry from workflow.
scientific_design.prior_work: R0 is retrospective-known-universality replication and does not establish R1 outcome.

preregistration_integrity.disclosure: This experiment is constructed before first CI run; no empirical result is asserted in this plan.
preregistration_integrity.published_data: Only synthetic data generated in CI; no paid external datasets or Rowan.
preregistration_integrity.source_commit_policy: Report exact PR/commit SHA and CI run before any scientific promotion.

scientific_ceiling: Recovering synthetic known formulas is a bounded software capability; it is not novel physics, not mathematical evidence for divine authorship, not a proof of computational ontology, and not P=NP.
next_stage: R1.1 independent external scientific benchmark with data license, genuine heldout evaluator and alternative regression baseline; R2 matched-budget agents.
